    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AddColumnCommand
    THe AddColumnCommand adds a column to an already existing table and sets all values to null.
    AggregateCommand
    The AggregateCommand finds the Max, Min, Mul and Sum of 2 fields within a table.
    Application
     
    CloseCommand
    The close command closes the file and deletes any information in the program.
    Command
    The command interface contains a single execute method which all classes have.
    CountCommand
    The CountCommand finds the number of rows within a table that contain a specific value.
    Database
    The Database class holds all the tables in the database.
    DataField
    The DataField Interface is implemented by all the types of data the database can have.
    DeleteCommand
    The DeleteCommand class allows the user to delete a row within the table with a specfic value.
    DescribeCommand
    The DescribeCommand outputs the columns and the type of field they input.
    DoubleField
    DoubleField contains all values in the database of the Double primitive.
    ExitCommand
    The ExitCommand class turns off the application.
    ExportCommand
    The export command borrows on the save command functioning identically to the "save as" version of it.
    HelpCommand
    The HelpCommand class outputs the user a list of all the commands and how to use them.
    ImportCommand
    The Import command takes the opened file as input and then inputs the data inside into the database.
    InnerJoinCommand
    InnerJoinCommand takes two tables and joins them based on matching values within 2 of their columns.
    InsertCommand
    The InsertCommand allows the user to insert a row within the table.
    IntField
    IntField contains all values in the database of the int primitive.
    NullField
    NullField contains all values in the database that are empty, outputting "Null" in place of them.
    OpenCommand
    The OpenCommand opens a file and thus allows all the other commands of the application to be usable.
    Parser
    The Parser class reads input, contains commands and then outputs whatever those commands return.
    PrintCommand
    The PrintCommand outputs the first 20 rows of a table.
    RenameCommand
    The RenameCommand changes the name of a certain table given as an input by the user.
    Row
    The row contains all the information for a single row of a table in the database.
    SaveCommand
    The save command takes either a table or the currently opened file and then saves it in another file.
    SelectCommand
    The SelectCommand finds all rows within the table with a specific value and outputs it.
    ShowTablesCommand
    The ShowTablesCommand Outputs a list of all the tables in the database.
    StringField
    StringField contains all values in the database that are Strings.
    Table
    The Table class contains a LinkedHashMap of rows and a name for the table object.
    UpdateCommand
    The UpdateCommand looks at a perticular field within the table and replaces it.
